scope: new development protocol, no final-test unlock or Q1 acceptance
authorization: User approved new S1 support, S1=2000/reference1000/S2=S3=1000 on this chat; best fixed KL weight requested

controlled_generator.branch_strength: m=1/lambda_max(Q.T S^-1 R S^-1 Q), maximizing minimum branch covariance transfer subject to exact moment compensation; no search against model/probe/Psi
controlled_generator.branch_directions: three largest eigenvectors of generator weighted moment S
controlled_generator.branch_labels: uniform tetrahedron vertex independent of u,v inside fixed Omega; g=0 outside
controlled_generator.bump: flat interior with C1 cosine-squared joining band; angular band=3*observation_noise_std / min(renderer tangent norm); no model outcome input

model: unchanged pinned historical 03 MLPVAE/ConvVAE, including original logvar clamp [-12,12]; saturation always logged

readout.license: Torchvision implementation BSD-3-Clause; no inherited license claim for pretrained weights
readout.note: Same official transform and weights as prepared reader; microbatch chosen only by engineering timing; no outcome-based readout selection

controlled_probe_head.standardization: probe-train mean and population std only; floor 1e-6
controlled_probe_head.selection: minimum probe-val cross entropy; ties choose earlier listed lambda; probe-test never selects

dsprites: all six scales, shape0 orientation0, x/y vary
shapes3d: all three colors and scale, shape0 orientation0

orientation_tasks.dsprites_primary: shape2 only; numeric orientation modulo 2pi, eight bins; raw40 all-shape supporting always retained
orientation_tasks.shapes3d_primary: shape0 only, original15 orientations; raw15 all-shape supporting always retained

probe_noise: independent fixed per data-role namespace, shared over time and paired branches/capacities

stable_control.signal_reference: same frozen reference as changing branch

source_identity_policy: pixel-equivalence-aware global roles; CIFAR original-image identity preserved across corruptions; no cross-role same physical source
probe_role_sampling: primary probe images without replacement and with all declared classes; raw orientation auxiliaries retain original label limitations
calibration_sampling: distinct physical source images, no within-role replacement, all three S1 roles mutually exclusive
models_selected_by: previous development reconstruction means, not signal/probe outcome; uncontrolled dimension effects not called strict compute matching

variance_matching.selection_uses: mean_total_variance only, no Psi or probes
